reason: ATLAS requires a developer account obtained through TBAuctions sales/API Support, and documented requests are scoped by company and/or buyer. Public documentation does not establish a reusable open historical event feed or a licence for BMA modelling.
what_this_does_not_claim: that TBAuctions has no industrial market data
that a future explicit data partnership cannot support a distinct campaign
that a login alone is evidence access or modelling permission
next_source_rule: Evaluate a new candidate only if its public data contract, reproducible access and modelling/reuse licence can be verified before any modelling work.
